title: For Donors | Help Colombia Now
description: Meaningfully support reviewed, community-led fundraising efforts in Colombia.
intro: This project was created to find, review, and amplify credible fundraisers organized by Colombian volunteers and community groups.
scam-body: Since the earthquake, fake campaigns impersonating recognized organizations have circulated, along with calls claiming a family member is trapped or injured to pressure you into transferring money immediately. No legitimate organization — including Colombia's ICBF — will ask you for money by phone or message.
scam-1: Only donate through the links, accounts, or Bre-B keys published directly on the organization's own official page or on this site.
scam-2: Be wary of urgent requests by phone, WhatsApp, or social media pressuring you to transfer money immediately.
scam-3: Never transfer money to a personal savings account, even if someone claims to represent an official campaign.
scam-4: If you spot a possible scam, report it to the Colombian Police's virtual CAI or via WhatsApp at +57 323 273 3411.
why-body: Local volunteers can respond quickly to urgent needs because they know their communities directly. Although large organizations play a vital role, they cannot always reach every affected group immediately. Community initiatives help close that gap with food, clothing, hygiene products, transportation, and other essential support.
vet-1: Multiple people on our team evaluate the information independently.
vet-2: We only publish initiatives that demonstrate an ability to deliver aid.
vet-3: We only support fundraisers hosted or backed by credible social media pages or websites.
vet-4: We work with trusted people connected to local volunteer networks in Colombia.
disclaimer: We review every initiative carefully, but the final decision to donate is yours. Before contributing, verify the legitimacy of the account or page hosting the fundraiser.
how-body: Select “Donate Now” to view the information provided by the organization. This site does not process or store payments.
colombia-methods: bank transfer and other verified local methods
international-methods: only use options published and verified by the organization
